Chapter 7133: A Single Thread Of Fate Binds Eternally

Chapter 7133: A Single Thread Of Fate Binds Eternally

“Brother, I am blind, so is my mind. If I hit something, I will keep going until it breaks without turning back, this is the stubbornness of an old blind.” Hao Cai said.

“Have it your way.” Death Serpent wished to finish this as fast as possible and released his temporal ocean in Hao Cai’s direction.

Karma and depth of space couldn’t stop the corroding flow, withering away like ashes. Even if immortals were living in dimensional pockets, they still wouldn’t stop the flow regardless of their treasure and techniques.

“Not bad. “Hao Cai summoned a door and shouted: “Oblivion Gate!”

“Boom!” Within the gate was an endless space that could encompass everything. He used it to suck in the temporal flood.

“Let’s see how endless it is!” Death Serpent summoned a portal as well, accelerating the flow. It became resplendent and could drown Divine Firmament.

Spectators turned pale in horror upon watching the radiant flood. Hao Cai didn’t dare to underestimate the opponent and summoned his legacy, fueling more power into the gate.

Nonetheless, he turned red from exerting too much energy.

“Down!” Ninth Lady burned her true blood for more power, wanting to end the process.

The strings pulled tightly on all corners in Divine Firmament, giving her more leverage for the pull.

Although living beings feared the increased tension and vibration, they cheered for her. The shattering of Divine Firmament didn’t necessarily mean death. The chance of survival was still better than the alternative.

“A single thread of fate binds eternally!” Her primordial cultivation unleashed its full potential.

The strings dragged the layers together, seemingly turning into a bloody jaw behind her. The strings coming from it looked like a red tongue, wrapping around the palace.

“What is this technique?!” An immortal shouted.

“This... this is a divine beast’s power.” Stone Immortal said.

“Not just any divine beast, it’s the gluttonous beast’s gift, Limitless Devouring.” Chongming Immortal Monarch said.

“Impossible, how can that be cultivated by an outsider?” Stone Immortal said.

Innate gifts of the divine beasts could be cultivated to the apex level. Thus, as long as they could become celestial immortals, they would automatically wield apex powers. Other races needed to create their own.

Others couldn’t duplicate these innate gifts either but Ninth Lady showed them otherwise.

“It’s not quite the innate gift, but from derivation instead.” The monarch took his time observing the bloody jaw.
